slides.text: Most people don't lack boundaries. They lack *words*.
To say no: *"I can do X by Friday, or Y by Monday. Which matters more?"*
To skip a meeting: *"I can't attend. Please send notes."*
After hours: *"I'll pick this up first thing tomorrow."*
Write your script *before* you need it.

slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily

caption:
